dishes.name: Bossche bol
dishes.desc: Large choux ball filled with whipped cream and coated in dark chocolate. The pastry of 's-Hertogenbosch, eaten with a fork or a very wide mouth.

dishes.name: Duingoed cheese
dishes.desc: Prize-winning cheese made by farmers around the Loon and Drunen dunes, a short ride from Den Bosch. Found in local cheese shops and farm stalls.

dishes.name: Brabant buffalo mozzarella
dishes.desc: Buffalo mozzarella from Brabant farms, one of the province's recognised local cheeses. Sold at farm shops and markets around the city.

dishes.name: Moorkop
dishes.desc: Choux pastry with cream and a chocolate glaze, a sibling of the Bossche bol. Sold in the city's patisseries.
